title: Mob lynches man in Jharkhand after minor girl alleges he raped her
summary: A mob lynched a 22-year-old man accused of abduction and sexual assault in Jharkhand after a minor girl alleged he raped her. The victim died from his injuries. Eight individuals were arrested late Tuesday in connection with the incident.
summary_points: A 22-year-old man was accused of abduction and sexual assault by a minor girl.
The victim died from his injuries after being beaten by a mob.
Eight individuals were arrested late Tuesday in connection with the incident.
